query: I want to open a leveraged XLM position on XOXNO but route the swap through my own DEX contract instead of the aggregator. How do I do that from a contract?
expected_behavior: Uses `flash_position` with an `execute_flash_position` receiver, not `multiply` (whose `swap: Bytes` must be aggregator router bytes produced off-chain) and not a cash `flash_loan`

Implements `execute_flash_position(env, initiator: Address, account_id: u64, asset: Address, amount: i128, fee: i128, amount_received: i128, controller: Address, data: Bytes)` with exactly that signature (the `xoxno_contract_sdk::lending::FlashPositionReceiver` trait fixes it); does not implement `execute_flash_loan` or `approve` the pool (there is no repayment pull, `fee` is 0)

Pushes the swapped collateral to `controller` (the callback argument) with a plain `token::Client::transfer(self, controller, amount)` from the receiver, which direct invoker auth covers; does not send it to the pool

Passes `mode` as `xoxno_contract_sdk::lending::controller::PositionMode::{Multiply, Long, Short}` (not `u32`, not `Normal` which reverts `InvalidPositionMode` #111) and `spoke_id >= 1`, `account_id` 0 to create

Declares `collaterals` with at least one entry and a strictly positive minimum, and lists the debt token in `refund_assets` to receive unspent debt tokens back to `caller`; states that leftover debt token on the controller does not auto-repay the account (debt stays minted until `repay`)
Requires the debt market to have `is_flashloanable` set (`FlashloanNotEnabled` #401) and notes the account must pass ordinary solvency gates after the callback
Gates the callback invoker to the trusted controller address held in storage; does not hardcode a contract id (addresses come from `configs/networks.json` / `xoxno-lending/addresses.md`)
machine_checkable: Generated Rust builds with `stellar contract build` against `soroban-sdk = "28"` and `xoxno-contract-sdk = "0.2"` in the eval crate
Source declares `execute_flash_position` (as a `pub fn` or as the `FlashPositionReceiver` trait method) with 8 parameters after `env`, contains no `execute_flash_loan`, and no `.approve(` call
